items.title: CoreWeave-Tied Data Center Project Kicks Off Junk-Bond Offering
items.summary: A group of banks led by Goldman Sachs Group Inc. has kicked off the sale of a roughly $1.1 billion junk bond to finance construction of a data center sponsored by affiliates of Blue Owl Capital Inc. and leased to CoreWeave Inc..

items.title: KKR Bets on Korea AI Supply Chain After Record $3 Billion Deals
items.summary: KKR & Co. expects more dealmaking opportunities in South Korea after plowing around $3 billion into the country this year, betting its central role in the global artificial-intelligence supply chain will fuel demand for everything from data centers to power.
